original_ai_output.title_zh: 奥贡州护士抗议医疗设备和人员不足
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥贡州阿贝奥库塔Aro联邦神经精神病医院的护士举行抗议，就基本医疗设备短缺、人员配备不足和工作条件恶劣向院方发出21天最后通牒。护士协会指出，三个病房需共用并排队使用一台血压监测仪。护士警告称，这些问题可能危及患者安全和医疗服务。

location.raw_text: Federal Neuropsychiatric Hospital, Aro, Abeokuta, Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 奥贡州阿贝奥库塔Aro联邦神经精神病医院护士举行抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nurses at the Federal Neuropsychiatric Hospital, Aro, Abeokuta, Ogun State, have issued a 21-day ultimatum

key_facts.fact: 护士就基本医疗设备短缺、人员不足和工作条件恶劣发出21天最后通牒
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: issued a 21-day ultimatum to the management to address shortages of essential medical equipment, inadequate staffing and poor working conditions

key_facts.fact: 护士称三个病房需共用并排队使用一台血压监测仪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: three hospital wards had to share and queue for a single blood pressure monitoring apparatus

key_facts.fact: 护士警告相关问题可能危及患者安全
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: warning that the challenges could compromise patient safety and healthcare delivery

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
院方是否回应或采取整改措施尚未证实
